--! id: zerobyw
--! name: zero搬运
--! version: 1.3

-- zero搬运：在线漫画阅读器（数据源 zerobyw33.com）
-- 主页是田字封面网格（2×2）：封面 + 最多 3 行标题；语音键进详情（大封面 + 简介），
-- 再按语音键进入阅读，左右键翻页。
-- 数据与图片由网关代理（/device/zb/*），设备只跟局域网网关通信。
-- 可用 API：ui.title/text/center/rect/image/footer/clear/size/measure/
--           flush/content_top/line_height、net.get、sys.env/log/pending/lib、on_idle
-- 1.3：迁移为 .lua 单文件包（--! 头部元数据即安装信息）；布局常量与文字排版
--      改用公共库 sys.lib("ui_kit")，缩小脚本体积、风格与漫巴士保持一致

-- 公共库：布局常量与排版统一走 ui_kit（固件 2.9.54 起；库缺失时显示降级页）
local kit = sys.lib("ui_kit")
if not kit then
  function draw()
    ui.clear()
    ui.title("zero搬运")
    ui.center("需要固件 2.9.54 以上", 300)
    ui.center("请在「小应用管理→制作提示词」同步公共库", 340)
    ui.footer("电源退出")
  end
  function on_key(action)
    if action == "back" then sys.exit() end
  end
  draw()
  ui.flush(true)
  return
end

local W, H, TOP, LH = kit.W, kit.H, kit.TOP, kit.LH
local MARGIN, GAP, PER_PAGE = kit.MARGIN, kit.GAP, kit.PER_PAGE
local GRID_Y, GRID_BOTTOM = kit.GRID_Y, kit.GRID_BOTTOM
local CELL_W, CELL_H = kit.CELL_W, kit.CELL_H
local COVER_W, COVER_H = kit.COVER_W, kit.COVER_H
-- 详情页是纵向列表：第 1 行本作（大封面 + 作者/状态/题材/简介），
-- 第 2 行起每条相关推荐占一行（左侧小封面 + 右侧书名），选中项随滚动保持在可视区
local DETAIL_TOP, DETAIL_BOTTOM = kit.DETAIL_TOP, kit.DETAIL_BOTTOM
local SELF_COVER_W, SELF_COVER_H, SELF_ROW_H =
  kit.SELF_COVER_W, kit.SELF_COVER_H, kit.SELF_ROW_H
local REL_COVER_W, REL_COVER_H, REL_ROW_H, REL_TEXT_X =
  kit.REL_COVER_W, kit.REL_COVER_H, kit.REL_ROW_H, kit.REL_TEXT_X
local DESC_LIMIT = 160         -- 简介字符上限，实际行数再按本作行高度裁剪
-- 收藏/历史合并列表：左封面 + 右书名 + 收藏星标，收藏块在上、分隔线之后是历史块
local LIB_ROW_H, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H, LIB_TOP, LIB_ROWS =
  kit.LIB_ROW_H, kit.LIB_COVER_W, kit.LIB_COVER_H, kit.LIB_TOP, kit.LIB_ROWS
local STAR_PBM = kit.STAR_PBM
local TAB = kit.TAB
local CHAR = kit.CHAR

local view = "latest"          -- latest | tags | cat | lib | detail | read
local sel = 1
local problem = nil            -- 非空时整屏显示错误，语音键重试

local latest_items = {}
local tag_items = {}
local cat_items = {}
local cat_name = ""
local cat_tag = ""
local detail = nil
local detail_err = nil         -- 详情数据没拉到时，详情页内提示并可重试
local chapters = {}
local reader = nil             -- { id, title, ch, pages, index, image, err }
local progress = {}            -- 漫画 id -> { ch, index }：历史续读用
local fav_items = {}           -- 收藏：{ id, text }
local fav_ids = {}             -- id -> true，便于判断
local hist_items = {}          -- 历史：{ id, text, ch, index }，最近观看在前
local detail_sel = 1           -- 详情列表选中行：1=本作，2 起对应 related[detail_sel-1]
local detail_stack = {}        -- 从相关推荐进入的详情返回栈
local toast = nil              -- 一次性提示（收藏/清空等），下次按键后清除
local FAV_LIMIT = 20
local HIST_LIMIT = 12

local covers = {}              -- "id:w:h" -> PBM 字符串（小应用堆只有 512KB，必须限量）
local cover_state = {}         -- "id:w:h" -> "none"（站点没有真封面）/ "fail"（取图失败）
local cover_order = {}
local COVER_LIMIT = 14

-- ===== 网关请求 =====
local function api(path)
  local base = sys.env("gateway")
  if not base then return nil end
  if base:sub(-1) == "/" then base = base:sub(1, -2) end
  local url = base .. path
  local token = sys.env("token")
  if token then
    url = url .. (path:find("?", 1, true) and "&token=" or "?token=") .. token
  end
  return url
end

-- 网络失败时不抛错，返回 nil + 可读原因，界面统一显示
-- 漫画数据经网关中转（网关最坏约 25 秒），这里留 32 秒；不要在回调里连续堆多个长请求
local function fetch(path, timeout)
  local url = api(path)
  if not url then return nil, "未配置网关地址" end
  local body, err = net.get(url, timeout or 32000)
  if not body then return nil, err or "网络请求失败" end
  if body:sub(1, 4) == "ERR " then return nil, body:sub(5) end
  return body
end

local function fields(line)
  local out = {}
  for field in (line .. TAB):gmatch("([^" .. TAB .. "]*)" .. TAB) do out[#out + 1] = field end
  return out
end

-- 列表协议：total=N，其后每行 "id<TAB>标题"
local function parse_list(body)
  local out = {}
  for line in body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    if line:sub(1, 6) ~= "total=" then
      local parts = fields(line)
      if parts[1] and parts[1] ~= "" then
        out[#out + 1] = { id = parts[1], text = parts[2] or "" }
      end
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function load_latest()
  local body, err = fetch("/device/zb/latest?limit=27")
  if not body then return nil, err end
  return parse_list(body)
end

local function load_tags()
  local body, err = fetch("/device/zb/tags")
  if not body then return nil, err end
  return parse_list(body)
end

local function load_category(tag_id)
  local body, err = fetch("/device/zb/list?limit=27&tag=" .. tag_id)
  if not body then return nil, err end
  return parse_list(body)
end

local function load_detail(id)
  local body, err = fetch("/device/zb/detail?id=" .. id)
  if not body then return nil, err end
  local info = { title = "", author = "", status = "", tags = "", desc = "" }
  local list = {}
  local related = {}
  for line in body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    if line:sub(1, 2) == "c=" then
      local parts = fields(line:sub(3))
      if parts[1] then list[#list + 1] = { id = parts[1], label = parts[2] or "最新话" } end
    elseif line:sub(1, 2) == "r=" then
      -- 相关推荐：r=<漫画 id><TAB>标题
      local parts = fields(line:sub(3))
      if parts[1] then related[#related + 1] = { id = parts[1], text = parts[2] or parts[1] } end
    else
      local key, value = line:match("^(%a+)=(.*)$")
      if key then info[key] = value end
    end
  end
  return info, list, related
end

-- ===== 文字排版与通用绘制（来自公共库 ui_kit）=====
local wrap_lines, fit_line = kit.wrap_lines, kit.fit_line
local truncate_utf8, center_in = kit.truncate_utf8, kit.center_in
local show_loading = kit.show_loading

-- ===== 封面 =====
local function cover_key(id, w, h)
  return id .. ":" .. w .. ":" .. h
end

-- ===== 设备本地缓存（固件 2.9.7 起的 cache API，1MB/应用）=====
-- 封面与正文页都落到设备 SPIFFS：重看、翻页、网关不在线时优先读本地，
-- 不再只依赖网关侧缓存。旧固件没有 cache 全局，读到 nil 时全部退化为直接取网关。
local CACHE = cache
local CACHE_SCHEME = "v1"

-- djb2 归一化成 8 位十六进制：SPIFFS 对象名上限 32 字节，缓存键必须短
local function key_hash(text)
  local h = 5381
  for i = 1, #text do h = (h * 33 + text:byte(i)) % 4294967296 end
  return string.format("%08x", h)
end

local function page_cache_key(ch, index)
  return "p" .. key_hash(CACHE_SCHEME .. ch) .. string.format("%03d", index)
end

-- 封面缓存键带上尺寸：网格 140×186 与详情 150×200 曾共用后缀导致互相顶替
local function cover_cache_key(id, w, h)
  return "c" .. key_hash(CACHE_SCHEME .. id) .. w .. "x" .. h
end

-- 只认尺寸合理的 P4：坏缓存/异常响应里的错误宽高会让贴图循环长时间空转
local function pbm_ok(body)
  if type(body) ~= "string" or body:sub(1, 2) ~= "P4" then return false end
  local w, h = body:match("^P4%s*(%d+)%s+(%d+)")
  if not w then return false end
  return tonumber(w) <= W and tonumber(h) <= 1200
end

local function cache_get(key)
  if not CACHE then return nil end
  local body = CACHE.get(key)
  if pbm_ok(body) then return body end
  return nil
end

local function cache_put(key, pbm)
  if not CACHE or not pbm then return end
  CACHE.set(key, pbm)
end

-- ===== 收藏与观看历史（持久化到本地 cache，退出应用后仍保留）=====
-- 存成每行一条的文本，读取时按行拆分；标题里的换行/制表符会破坏协议，写入前统一压成空格
local FAV_KEY, HIST_KEY = "fav", "hist"

local function meta_text(text)
  return (text:gsub("[\t\r\n]", " "))
end

local function meta_read(key)
  if not CACHE then return "" end
  local body = CACHE.get(key)
  if type(body) ~= "string" then return "" end
  return body
end

local function meta_write(key, body)
  if not CACHE then return end
  if body == "" then
    CACHE.del(key)
  else
    CACHE.set(key, body)
  end
end

local function save_favorites()
  local lines = {}
  for _, item in ipairs(fav_items) do
    lines[#lines + 1] = item.id .. TAB .. meta_text(item.text)
  end
  meta_write(FAV_KEY, table.concat(lines, "\n"))
end

local function save_history()
  local lines = {}
  for _, item in ipairs(hist_items) do
    lines[#lines + 1] = item.id .. TAB .. item.ch .. TAB .. tostring(item.index) .. TAB ..
      meta_text(item.text)
  end
  meta_write(HIST_KEY, table.concat(lines, "\n"))
  -- 顺手刷新收藏的缓存 LRU 位置，避免长时间看漫画时被页面图片挤出配额
  if #fav_items > 0 then save_favorites() end
end

local function load_meta()
  for line in meta_read(FAV_KEY):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    local parts = fields(line)
    if parts[1] and parts[1] ~= "" and not fav_ids[parts[1]] then
      fav_ids[parts[1]] = true
      fav_items[#fav_items + 1] = { id = parts[1], text = parts[2] or parts[1] }
    end
  end
  for line in meta_read(HIST_KEY):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    local parts = fields(line)
    if parts[1] and parts[1] ~= "" then
      local index = tonumber(parts[3]) or 0
      hist_items[#hist_items + 1] = {
        id = parts[1], ch = parts[2] or "", index = index, text = parts[4] or parts[1],
      }
      if parts[2] and parts[2] ~= "" then
        progress[parts[1]] = { ch = parts[2], index = index }
      end
    end
  end
end

local function toggle_favorite(item)
  if fav_ids[item.id] then
    fav_ids[item.id] = nil
    for i = #fav_items, 1, -1 do
      if fav_items[i].id == item.id then table.remove(fav_items, i) end
    end
    toast = "已取消收藏"
  else
    fav_ids[item.id] = true
    table.insert(fav_items, 1, { id = item.id, text = item.text })
    while #fav_items > FAV_LIMIT do table.remove(fav_items) end
    toast = "已收藏"
  end
  save_favorites()
end

-- 每次成功取到一页就更新历史，保证退出应用后还能从上次页码续读
local function record_history(id, title, ch, index)
  if not id or id == "" then return end
  for i = #hist_items, 1, -1 do
    if hist_items[i].id == id then table.remove(hist_items, i) end
  end
  table.insert(hist_items, 1, {
    id = id, text = (title and title ~= "") and title or id, ch = ch, index = index,
  })
  while #hist_items > HIST_LIMIT do table.remove(hist_items) end
  progress[id] = { ch = ch, index = index }
  save_history()
end

local function remember_cover(key, pbm)
  covers[key] = pbm
  -- 同一 key 重复写入时先移除旧位置：否则淘汰最早项时会把刚存下的封面误删
  for i = #cover_order, 1, -1 do
    if cover_order[i] == key then table.remove(cover_order, i) end
  end
  cover_order[#cover_order + 1] = key
  if #cover_order > COVER_LIMIT then
    local old = table.remove(cover_order, 1)
    covers[old] = nil
  end
end

-- 取封面：设备本地缓存 → 内存缓存 → 网关（封面由网关缩放+抖动成 PBM）
-- 失败时记下状态：站点只有占位图的漫画返回「无封面」，网络问题记「失败」，避免一直显示加载中
-- 封面超时压到 4 秒：切换选项不能被一张图卡住，慢图记为失败，空闲时再重试
local function get_cover(id, w, h, timeout)
  local key = cover_key(id, w, h)
  if covers[key] then return covers[key] end
  local local_key = cover_cache_key(id, w, h)
  local cached = cache_get(local_key)
  if cached then
    cover_state[key] = nil
    remember_cover(key, cached)
    return cached
  end
  local body, err = fetch("/device/zb/cover?id=" .. id .. "&w=" .. w .. "&h=" .. h,
                          timeout or 4000)
  if pbm_ok(body) then
    cover_state[key] = nil
    cache_put(local_key, body)
    remember_cover(key, body)
    return body
  end
  cover_state[key] = (err and err:find("无封面", 1, true)) and "none" or "fail"
  return nil
end

-- 封面位上的提示文字：未知=加载中，已知状态不再重复请求
local function cover_note(id, w, h)
  local state = cover_state[cover_key(id, w, h)]
  if state == "none" then return "无封面" end
  if state == "fail" then return "加载失败" end
  return "加载中…"
end

-- ===== 田字网格 =====
local function page_of(index)
  return math.floor((index - 1) / PER_PAGE) + 1
end

local function page_count(items)
  return math.max(1, math.ceil(#items / PER_PAGE))
end

local function cell_rect(slot)
  local col = (slot - 1) % 2
  local row = math.floor((slot - 1) / 2)
  return MARGIN + col * (CELL_W + GAP), GRID_Y + row * (CELL_H + GAP)
end

local function cover_origin(cx, cy, w)
  return cx + math.floor((CELL_W - w) / 2), cy + 6
end

local draw_frame = kit.draw_frame

local function grid_items()
  if view == "tags" then return tag_items end
  if view == "cat" then return cat_items end
  return latest_items        -- lib 是列表页，另有 lib_entries()
end

local function grid_title()
  if view == "tags" then return "分类" end
  if view == "cat" then return "分类 · " .. cat_name end
  return "最新更新"
end

local function grid_hint()
  if view == "tags" then return "语音查看 · 左右切换 · 右长按最新" end
  if view == "cat" then return "语音打开 · 左右切换 · 左长按返回" end
  -- 收藏/历史是独立列表页，只能在最新页长按左键进入；数量直接写进提示，
  -- 否则用户很难发现这一页的存在
  local fav = #fav_items
  local hist = #hist_items
  if fav + hist > 0 then
    return "语音打开 · 左长按→收藏" .. fav .. "/历史" .. hist .. " · 右长按分类"
  end
  return "语音打开 · 左长按→收藏/历史 · 右长按分类"
end

local function empty_note()
  return "暂无内容 · 语音重试"
end

local function draw_grid()
  local items = grid_items()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title(grid_title())
  local first = (page_of(sel) - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1

  if #items == 0 then
    center_in(empty_note(), 0, TOP + 150, W)
  end

  for slot = 1, PER_PAGE do
    local item = items[first + slot - 1]
    local cx, cy = cell_rect(slot)
    if item then
      local pbm = covers[cover_key(item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H)]
      local ix, iy = cover_origin(cx, cy, COVER_W)
      if pbm then
        ui.image(pbm, ix, iy)
      else
        ui.rect(ix, iy, COVER_W, COVER_H, false)
        center_in(cover_note(item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H), ix,
                  iy + math.floor(COVER_H / 2) - math.floor(LH / 2), COVER_W)
      end
      -- 漫画名自动换行，最多 3 行，超出加省略号
      local lines = wrap_lines(item.text, CELL_W - 16)
      if #lines > 3 then
        lines = { lines[1], lines[2], fit_line(lines[3] .. "…", CELL_W - 16) }
      end
      local ty = iy + COVER_H + 6
      for i = 1, math.min(#lines, 3) do
        ui.text(lines[i], cx + 8, ty + (i - 1) * LH, CELL_W - 16)
      end
    end
  end

  -- 选中框最后画，保证不被封面盖住
  local slot = (sel - 1) % PER_PAGE + 1
  local cx, cy = cell_rect(slot)
  draw_frame(cx, cy, CELL_W, CELL_H)
  local hint = toast and (toast .. " · " .. grid_hint()) or grid_hint()
  ui.footer(hint .. "  " .. page_of(sel) .. "/" .. page_count(items))
end

-- 先画文字刷屏，再逐张补封面：字体优先、每来一张封面就局部刷新，用户能看到进度
-- 单张失败不再中断后面的封面（之前第一张失败就 break，导致第 3、4 格一直停在加载中）
-- 分类页用纯文字列表（不拉封面），点进具体分类后才显示田字封面网格
local TAG_ROW_H = LH + 12
local TAG_TOP = GRID_Y
local TAG_ROWS = math.max(1, math.floor((GRID_BOTTOM - GRID_Y) / TAG_ROW_H))

local function draw_tags()
  local items = tag_items
  ui.clear()
  ui.title(grid_title())
  local rows = math.min(TAG_ROWS, #items)
  -- 选中项超出可视区时滚动窗口，保证高亮行始终可见
  local first = 1
  if #items > rows then
    first = math.max(1, math.min(sel - rows + 1, #items - rows + 1))
  end
  for i = 1, rows do
    local item = items[first + i - 1]
    if item then
      ui.text(fit_line(item.text, W - 48), 24, TAG_TOP + (i - 1) * TAG_ROW_H + 4, W - 48)
    end
  end
  local slot = sel - first + 1
  ui.rect(16, TAG_TOP + (slot - 1) * TAG_ROW_H, W - 32, TAG_ROW_H - 2, false)
  ui.footer(#items == 0 and "暂无分类 · 语音重试"
             or "语音查看 · 左右切换 · 右长按最新  " .. sel .. "/" .. #items)
end

-- full=true 用于切换视图（整屏全刷清残影）；翻页/滚动只用局刷，面板自己做差分，
-- 屏幕上只会更新变化的格子，不会整屏闪一下
local function preview_grid(full)
  if view == "tags" then
    draw_tags()
    ui.flush(full == true)
    return
  end
  local items = grid_items()
  draw_grid()
  ui.flush(full == true)
  local first = (page_of(sel) - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1
  for slot = 1, PER_PAGE do
    local item = items[first + slot - 1]
    local key = item and cover_key(item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H)
    -- 只补还未知的格子；已确认无封面/失败的直接保持提示文字
    if key and not covers[key] and not cover_state[key] then
      -- 有按键排队就先让出：左右键立即响应，剩下的封面交给空闲回调 on_idle 慢慢补
      if sys.pending and sys.pending() then return end
      local cx, cy = cell_rect(slot)
      local ix, iy = cover_origin(cx, cy, COVER_W)
      if get_cover(item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H) then
        ui.image(covers[key], ix, iy)
      else
        center_in(cover_note(item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H), ix,
                  iy + math.floor(COVER_H / 2) - math.floor(LH / 2), COVER_W)
      end
      ui.flush()
    end
  end
end

-- ===== 收藏与历史（同一页列表）=====
-- 收藏块置顶，历史块用分隔线隔开；历史里已收藏的漫画同样显示星标
local function lib_entries()
  local list = {}
  for _, item in ipairs(fav_items) do list[#list + 1] = { item = item, kind = "fav" } end
  for _, item in ipairs(hist_items) do list[#list + 1] = { item = item, kind = "hist" } end
  return list
end

local function lib_page_of(index)
  return math.floor((index - 1) / LIB_ROWS) + 1
end

local function lib_page_count(total)
  return math.max(1, math.ceil(total / LIB_ROWS))
end

local function lib_row_xy(row)
  return 16, LIB_TOP + (row - 1) * LIB_ROW_H + 3
end

local function draw_lib()
  local entries = lib_entries()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("我的收藏与历史")
  if #entries == 0 then
    center_in("还没有收藏与观看记录", 0, TOP + 150, W)
  end
  if sel > #entries then sel = #entries end
  if sel < 1 then sel = 1 end

  local first = (lib_page_of(sel) - 1) * LIB_ROWS + 1
  for row = 1, LIB_ROWS do
    local index = first + row - 1
    local entry = entries[index]
    local y = LIB_TOP + (row - 1) * LIB_ROW_H
    -- 历史块第一项上方画分隔线（没有收藏时不用画）
    if index == #fav_items + 1 and #fav_items > 0 and #hist_items > 0 then
      ui.rect(16, y - 5, W - 32, 1, true)
    end
    if entry then
      local item = entry.item
      local ix, iy = lib_row_xy(row)
      local pbm = covers[cover_key(item.id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H)]
      if pbm then
        ui.image(pbm, ix, iy)
      else
        ui.rect(ix, iy, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H, false)
        center_in(cover_note(item.id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H), ix,
                  iy + math.floor(LIB_COVER_H / 2) - math.floor(LH / 2), LIB_COVER_W)
      end
      -- 书名最多两行，右侧留出星标位置
      local tx = ix + LIB_COVER_W + 14
      local tw = W - tx - 40
      local lines = wrap_lines(item.text, tw)
      if #lines > 2 then
        lines[2] = fit_line(lines[2] .. "…", tw)
        lines[3] = nil
      end
      local ty = y + 3 + math.floor((LIB_COVER_H - #lines * LH) / 2)
      for i = 1, #lines do ui.text(lines[i], tx, ty + (i - 1) * LH, tw) end
      if fav_ids[item.id] then ui.image(STAR_PBM, W - 16 - 20, y + 8) end
      if index == sel then ui.rect(8, y - 2, W - 16, LIB_ROW_H - 2, false) end
    end
  end

  local hint = toast or "语音打开 · 长按收藏 · 左最新 右清空"
  ui.footer(hint .. "  " .. lib_page_of(sel) .. "/" .. lib_page_count(#entries))
end

-- 先画文字刷屏，再只补当前页缺的封面，每张取回后局部刷新
local function preview_lib(full)
  draw_lib()
  ui.flush(full == true)
  local entries = lib_entries()
  local first = (lib_page_of(sel) - 1) * LIB_ROWS + 1
  for row = 1, LIB_ROWS do
    local entry = entries[first + row - 1]
    if entry then
      local key = cover_key(entry.item.id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H)
      if not covers[key] and not cover_state[key] then
        -- 有按键排队先让出，封面交给 on_idle 补
        if sys.pending and sys.pending() then return end
        local ix, iy = lib_row_xy(row)
        local pbm = get_cover(entry.item.id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H)
        if pbm then
          ui.image(pbm, ix, iy)
        else
          center_in(cover_note(entry.item.id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H), ix,
                    iy + math.floor(LIB_COVER_H / 2) - math.floor(LH / 2), LIB_COVER_W)
        end
        ui.flush()
      end
    end
  end
end

-- ===== 详情 =====
-- 详情页按纵向列表排布：第 1 行本作，之后每条相关推荐一行；选中行滚动保持在可视区
local function detail_related()
  return (detail and detail.related) or {}
end

local function detail_row_h(index)
  return index == 1 and SELF_ROW_H or REL_ROW_H
end

-- 选中行放不下时把窗口起点下移，避免选到屏幕外的推荐
local function detail_window()
  local first = 1
  local cap = DETAIL_BOTTOM - DETAIL_TOP
  while first < detail_sel do
    local used = 0
    for i = first, detail_sel do used = used + detail_row_h(i) end
    if used <= cap then break end
    first = first + 1
  end
  return first
end

-- 封面缺图时先画框和状态文字；本作可以用网格里的小封面先顶一下
local function draw_cover_at(id, w, h, x, y, use_grid)
  local pbm = covers[cover_key(id, w, h)]
  if pbm then
    ui.image(pbm, x, y)
    return
  end
  local grid = use_grid and covers[cover_key(id, COVER_W, COVER_H)]
  if grid then
    ui.image(grid, x + math.floor((w - COVER_W) / 2),
             y + math.floor((h - COVER_H) / 2))
    ui.rect(x, y, w, h, false)
    return
  end
  ui.rect(x, y, w, h, false)
  center_in(cover_note(id, w, h), x, y + math.floor(h / 2) - math.floor(LH / 2), w)
end

local function draw_detail()
  if not detail then return end
  ui.clear()

  -- 标题固定预留两行：第二行放不下时截断，保证列表起点固定
  local title_lines = wrap_lines(detail.title ~= "" and detail.title or "漫画详情", W - 32)
  if #title_lines > 2 then
    title_lines[2] = fit_line(title_lines[2] .. "…", W - 32)
    title_lines[3] = nil
  end
  for i = 1, #title_lines do
    center_in(title_lines[i], 0, TOP + 2 + (i - 1) * LH, W)
  end

  local related = detail_related()
  local total = 1 + #related
  if detail_sel < 1 then detail_sel = 1 end
  if detail_sel > total then detail_sel = total end

  local index = detail_window()
  local y = DETAIL_TOP
  while index <= total and y + detail_row_h(index) <= DETAIL_BOTTOM do
    if index == 1 then
      draw_cover_at(detail.id, SELF_COVER_W, SELF_COVER_H, 16, y, true)
      local tx = 16 + SELF_COVER_W + 14
      local tw = W - tx - 16
      if detail.loaded then
        local ty = y
        ui.text(fit_line("作者：" .. (detail.author ~= "" and detail.author or "未知"), tw),
                tx, ty, tw)
        ty = ty + LH
        -- 站点未登录只开放部分章节：状态行追加可读比例（locked 由网关上报）
        local locked_n = tonumber(detail.locked) or 0
        local status_text = detail.status ~= "" and detail.status or "未知"
        if locked_n > 0 and #chapters > 0 then
          status_text = status_text .. " 可读" .. #chapters .. "/" .. (#chapters + locked_n) .. "章"
        end
        ui.text(fit_line("状态：" .. status_text, tw), tx, ty, tw)
        ty = ty + LH
        ui.text(fit_line("题材：" .. (detail.tags ~= "" and detail.tags or "无"), tw), tx, ty, tw)
        ty = ty + LH + 4
        local desc = detail.desc
        if desc == "" then desc = "暂无简介" end
        if #desc > DESC_LIMIT then desc = truncate_utf8(desc, DESC_LIMIT) end
        local lines = wrap_lines(desc, tw)
        local max_lines = math.floor((y + SELF_COVER_H - ty) / LH)
        if #lines > max_lines then
          if max_lines > 0 then
            lines[max_lines] = fit_line(lines[max_lines] .. "…", tw)
            for i = max_lines + 1, #lines do lines[i] = nil end
          else
            lines = {}
          end
        end
        for i = 1, #lines do ui.text(lines[i], tx, ty + (i - 1) * LH, tw) end
      else
        ui.text(detail_err or "正在加载介绍…", tx, y, tw)
      end
      if detail_sel == 1 then draw_frame(8, y - 2, W - 16, SELF_ROW_H - 4) end
    else
      local item = related[index - 1]
      draw_cover_at(item.id, REL_COVER_W, REL_COVER_H, 16, y + 3, false)
      local tw = W - REL_TEXT_X - 16
      local lines = wrap_lines(item.text, tw)
      if #lines > 2 then
        lines[2] = fit_line(lines[2] .. "…", tw)
        lines[3] = nil
      end
      local ty = y + 3 + math.floor((REL_COVER_H - #lines * LH) / 2)
      for i = 1, #lines do ui.text(lines[i], REL_TEXT_X, ty + (i - 1) * LH, tw) end
      if detail_sel == index then draw_frame(8, y - 2, W - 16, REL_ROW_H - 4) end
    end
    y = y + detail_row_h(index)
    index = index + 1
  end

  if detail_err then
    ui.footer("语音直接观看 · 左长按返回")
  elseif not detail.loaded then
    ui.footer("请稍候 · 左长按返回")
  elseif #related == 0 then
    local label = chapters[1] and chapters[1].label
    if label then
      ui.footer("语音阅读 " .. label .. " · 左长按返回")
    else
      ui.footer("暂无章节 · 左长按返回")
    end
  elseif detail_sel == 1 then
    ui.footer("语音阅读 · 左右选推荐 · 左长按返回")
  else
    ui.footer("语音打开推荐 " .. (detail_sel - 1) .. "/" .. #related .. " · 左长按返回")
  end
end

-- 详情页先画文字（列表与选中框）并刷屏，再逐张补当前可视区的封面；
-- 封面没取到不影响左右切换选项，切换只改状态，不发起任何网络请求
local function preview_detail(full)
  if not detail then return end
  draw_detail()
  ui.flush(full == true)
  local related = detail_related()
  local total = 1 + #related
  local index = detail_window()
  local y = DETAIL_TOP
  local loaded = 0   -- 单次回调最多同步取 2 张，其余交给 on_idle，避免长时间阻塞主循环
  while index <= total and y + detail_row_h(index) <= DETAIL_BOTTOM do
    local id = index == 1 and detail.id or related[index - 1].id
    local w = index == 1 and SELF_COVER_W or REL_COVER_W
    local h = index == 1 and SELF_COVER_H or REL_COVER_H
    local key = cover_key(id, w, h)
    if not covers[key] and not cover_state[key] then
      -- 有按键排队先让出，封面交给 on_idle 补
      if sys.pending and sys.pending() then return end
      if loaded >= 2 then return end
      get_cover(id, w, h)
      loaded = loaded + 1
      draw_detail()
      ui.flush()
    end
    y = y + detail_row_h(index)
    index = index + 1
  end
end

-- ===== 阅读器 =====
-- 网关会在返回当前页后预取下一页；设备端再把下一页读进内存（reader.pre_*），
-- 翻页时直接复用，屏幕先局部刷新显示新页，再去取下一页，避免整屏全刷和长时间加载中
local draw_reader            -- 前置声明：turn_page / open_reader 里要先局部刷新当前页

-- 装载某页：blocking=true 直接等网络（进阅读时的第一页用）；
-- false 只用预取/本地缓存，未命中就登记 loading_index 交给 on_idle 后台取图，
-- on_key 立即返回不再被网络请求阻塞（翻页跟手，页脚马上显示加载状态）
local function load_page(index, blocking)
  if not reader or index < 0 or index >= reader.pages then return false end
  -- 已预取到内存的页：直接用，省一次网络往返
  if reader.pre_image and reader.pre_index == index then
    reader.image = reader.pre_image
    reader.pre_image = nil
    reader.pre_index = nil
    reader.index = index
    reader.err = nil
    reader.loading_index = nil
    record_history(reader.id, reader.title, reader.ch, index)
    return true
  end
  -- 设备本地缓存命中：重看同一页、或网关暂时不可用时也能翻页
  local local_key = page_cache_key(reader.ch, index)
  local cached = cache_get(local_key)
  if cached then
    reader.index = index
    reader.image = cached
    reader.err = nil
    reader.loading_index = nil
    record_history(reader.id, reader.title, reader.ch, index)
    return true
  end
  if not blocking then
    reader.loading_index = index   -- 目标页登记后由 on_idle 取回
    return false
  end
  reader.loading_index = nil
  -- 首次按 32 秒等；失败重试一次，超时缩到 15 秒，避免连续两个长超时把界面卡死
  local body, err = fetch("/device/zb/page?ch=" .. reader.ch .. "&n=" .. index)
  if not body then
    body, err = fetch("/device/zb/page?ch=" .. reader.ch .. "&n=" .. index, 15000)
  end
  if not body then
    reader.err = err or "取图失败"
    return false
  end
  -- 网关异常时可能返回 HTML/错误页（HTTP 仍是 200），非 PBM 不能当图片缓存，
  -- 否则下次命中还会显示坏图。图床偶发超时/403 时先重试一次，仍失败就把网关给的原因显示出来
  if not pbm_ok(body) then
    local reason = type(body) == "string" and body:match("^ERR%s*(.-)%s*$") or nil
    body, err = fetch("/device/zb/page?ch=" .. reader.ch .. "&n=" .. index, 20000)
    if not pbm_ok(body) then
      reader.err = reason or "取图失败（返回内容不是有效图片）"
      return false
    end
  end
  reader.index = index
  reader.image = body
  reader.err = nil
  cache_put(local_key, body)
  record_history(reader.id, reader.title, reader.ch, index)
  return true
end

-- 预取下一页：只在 on_idle 空闲时调用（有按键 sys.pending 会先让出），失败静默，翻页时再重试
local function prefetch_next()
  if not reader then return end
  local n = reader.index + 1
  if n >= reader.pages then return end
  if reader.pre_image and reader.pre_index == n then return end
  local local_key = page_cache_key(reader.ch, n)
  local cached = cache_get(local_key)
  if cached then
    reader.pre_index = n
    reader.pre_image = cached
    return
  end
  local body = fetch("/device/zb/page?ch=" .. reader.ch .. "&n=" .. n, 20000)
  if pbm_ok(body) then
    cache_put(local_key, body)
    reader.pre_index = n
    reader.pre_image = body
  end
end

-- 翻页只登记目标页并立即返回：预取/缓存命中就地显示，未命中由 on_idle 后台取图，
-- 底部提示栏马上显示「正在加载第 N 页」，按键不再被网络请求卡住
local function turn_page(step)
  if not reader then return end
  local next_index = reader.index + step
  if next_index < 0 then
    view = "detail"     -- 第一页继续左翻：回到详情
    reader = nil
    return
  end
  if next_index >= reader.pages then
    reader.err = "已经是最后一页"
    return
  end
  reader.err = nil
  load_page(next_index, false)
end

local function open_reader()
  if #chapters == 0 then
    problem = "该漫画还没有可阅读的章节"
    return
  end
  show_loading("zero搬运", "正在加载章节…")
  -- 续读历史时优先回到上次读的那一章；该章已不在列表里时退回第一章
  local saved = progress[detail.id]
  local ch = chapters[1].id
  if saved and saved.ch then
    for _, chapter in ipairs(chapters) do
      if chapter.id == saved.ch then
        ch = chapter.id
        break
      end
    end
  end
  local body = fetch("/device/zb/chapter?ch=" .. ch)
  if not body then
    problem = "章节加载失败"
    return
  end
  local pages = tonumber(body:match("pages=(%d+)"))
  if not pages or pages <= 0 then
    problem = "该章节暂无图片"
    return
  end
  -- 续读上次的页码：进度来自本地历史，退出小应用后仍然有效
  local start = 0
  if saved and saved.ch == ch and saved.index and saved.index < pages then start = saved.index end
  reader = { id = detail.id, title = detail.title, ch = ch, pages = pages, index = start,
             image = nil, err = nil, loading_index = nil }
  view = "read"
  -- 第一页必须先等网络装载完成再进阅读（进页面前已有「正在加载章节…」提示）；
  -- 之后各页的预取全部交给 on_idle 空闲时进行，不在按键回调里阻塞
  load_page(start, true)
  draw_reader()
  ui.flush()
end

function draw_reader()
  ui.clear()
  if reader.err and not reader.image then
    center_in(reader.err, 0, math.floor(H / 2) - 40, W)
    ui.footer("左长按返回详情")
    return
  end
  if reader.image then
    if not ui.image(reader.image, 0, TOP) then
      center_in("这一页图片格式异常", 0, math.floor(H / 2) - 40, W)
    end
  end
  -- 目标页还没取回来：底部显示加载状态而不是空页码，按键随时可继续操作
  if reader.loading_index then
    ui.footer("正在加载第 " .. (reader.loading_index + 1) .. "/" .. reader.pages
                  .. " 页 · 左右可改目标 · 左长按返回")
    return
  end
  local hint = "第 " .. (reader.index + 1) .. "/" .. reader.pages .. " 页"
  if reader.err then hint = reader.err .. " · " .. hint end
  ui.footer(hint .. " · 左右翻页 · 左长按返回")
end

local function draw_problem()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("zero搬运")
  ui.text(problem, 20, TOP + 120, W - 40)
  ui.footer("语音重试 · 电源退出")
end

function draw()
  if problem then
    draw_problem()
  elseif view == "read" then
    draw_reader()
  elseif view == "detail" then
    draw_detail()
  elseif view == "tags" then
    -- 分类页是文字列表，必须走 draw_tags，否则按键重绘会退回四宫格
    draw_tags()
  elseif view == "lib" then
    draw_lib()
  else
    draw_grid()
  end
end

-- ===== 数据装载 =====
local function retry()
  problem = nil
  if view == "latest" then
    show_loading("zero搬运", "正在获取最新连载…")
    latest_items, problem = load_latest()
    if not problem then preview_grid(true) end
  elseif view == "tags" then
    show_loading("zero搬运", "正在获取分类…")
    tag_items, problem = load_tags()
    if not problem then preview_grid(true) end
  elseif view == "cat" then
    show_loading("zero搬运", "正在加载分类…")
    cat_items, problem = load_category(cat_tag)
    if not problem then preview_grid(true) end
  elseif view == "detail" and detail then
    show_loading("zero搬运", "正在重新加载…")
    local from_view = detail.from_view
    local info, list, related = load_detail(detail.id)
    if info then
      info.id = detail.id
      info.from_view = from_view
      info.loaded = true
      info.related = related
      detail = info
      chapters = list
      detail_sel = 1
      detail_err = nil
      preview_detail(true)
    else
      detail_err = "介绍加载失败 · 语音直接观看"
      draw_detail()
      ui.flush()
    end
  end
end

local function open_comic(item, from_view, auto_read)
  -- 相关推荐越界或列表为空时可能传进 nil：直接忽略，避免整页报错退出
  if not item or not item.id then return end
  -- 从相关推荐进入时保留上一级详情与选中行，左长按可原样返回
  if from_view == "detail" then
    detail_stack[#detail_stack + 1] = {
      detail = detail, chapters = chapters, sel = detail_sel,
    }
  else
    detail_stack = {}
  end
  -- 先切到详情页（标题来自列表），再同步拉介绍：点击立刻有反馈，不会停在网格上等待
  detail = { id = item.id, title = item.text or "", author = "", status = "", tags = "",
             desc = "", related = {} }
  detail.from_view = from_view or view
  detail_err = nil
  chapters = {}
  detail_sel = 1
  view = "detail"
  sel = 1
  draw_detail()
  ui.flush(true)
  local info, list, related = load_detail(item.id)
  if not info then
    detail_err = "介绍加载失败 · 语音直接观看"
    draw_detail()
    ui.flush()
    return
  end
  info.id = item.id
  info.from_view = detail.from_view
  info.loaded = true
  info.related = related
  detail = info
  chapters = list
  detail_sel = 1
  detail_err = nil
  if auto_read and #list > 0 then
    open_reader()
  else
    -- 上面刚做过一次整屏全刷，这里只补内容并局刷，避免连续两次全刷
    preview_detail(false)
  end
end

-- 详情返回：相关推荐进来的一层层退回上一本（含原来选中的行），列表进来的回到原视图
local function leave_detail()
  if detail and detail.from_view == "detail" and #detail_stack > 0 then
    local prev = table.remove(detail_stack)
    detail = prev.detail
    chapters = prev.chapters or {}
    detail_sel = prev.sel or 1
    detail_err = nil
    view = "detail"
    preview_detail(true)
    return
  end
  local dest = (detail and detail.from_view) or "latest"
  if dest == "detail" then dest = "latest" end
  detail = nil
  chapters = {}
  detail_sel = 1
  detail_stack = {}
  sel = 1
  view = dest
  if dest == "lib" then preview_lib(true) else preview_grid(true) end
end

-- ===== 按键 =====
function on_key(action)
  if problem then
    if action == "ok" then retry() end
    return
  end
  toast = nil   -- 收藏/清空提示只保留到下一次按键

  if view == "read" then
    if not reader then return end
    if action == "next" or action == "ok" then
      turn_page(1)
    elseif action == "prev" then
      turn_page(-1)
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
      reader = nil
      view = "detail"
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "detail" then
    if not detail then
      -- 状态异常（detail 已被清空却仍停在详情视图）：退回列表，避免 nil 报错
      leave_detail()
      return
    end
    local related = detail_related()
    local total = 1 + #related
    if action == "prev" or action == "next" then
      -- 只改选中行：不取封面、不发网络请求，选中框立即响应
      local was_first = detail_window()
      detail_sel = detail_sel + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)
      if detail_sel < 1 then detail_sel = total end
      if detail_sel > total then detail_sel = 1 end
      -- 只有滚动窗口变了才重画这一屏（局刷），新出现的封面随后再补
      if detail_window() ~= was_first then preview_detail() end
      return
    end
    if action == "ok" then
      if detail_err then
        -- 介绍没加载出来时不再原地重试：只取章节列表，成功就直接进阅读
        show_loading("zero搬运", "正在加载章节…")
        local info, list = load_detail(detail.id)
        if info and list and #list > 0 then
          chapters = list
          detail_err = nil
          open_reader()
        else
          detail_err = info and "该漫画暂无可读章节 · 左长按返回"
                              or "章节加载失败 · 左长按返回"
          if detail then detail.loaded = false end
          draw_detail()
          ui.flush()
        end
      elseif not detail.loaded then
        return
      elseif detail_sel == 1 then
        open_reader()
      else
        -- 列表里选中的是推荐，语音键打开它自己的详情
        open_comic(related[detail_sel - 1], "detail")
      end
    elseif action == "voice_long" then
      -- 长按语音始终阅读本作，不受当前选中行影响
      if detail and detail.loaded and not detail_err then open_reader() end
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
      leave_detail()
    end
    return
  end

  -- 收藏/历史合并列表单独处理：收藏块在上，历史块在下
  if view == "lib" then
    local entries = lib_entries()
    if action == "prev_long" then
      view = "latest"
      sel = 1
      preview_grid(true)
    elseif action == "next_long" then
      -- 只清历史，保存的收藏不动
      hist_items = {}
      progress = {}
      save_history()
      sel = 1
      toast = "历史记录已清空"
    elseif action == "voice_long" then
      local entry = entries[sel]
      if entry then
        toggle_favorite(entry.item)
        -- 收藏状态变化会让条目换位置：重新定位到刚操作的那本漫画
        local updated = lib_entries()
        sel = math.min(sel, math.max(1, #updated))
        for i, e in ipairs(updated) do
          if e.item.id == entry.item.id and e.kind == entry.kind then
            sel = i
            break
          end
        end
      end
    elseif action == "prev" or action == "next" then
      if #entries == 0 then return end
      local was = lib_page_of(sel)
      sel = sel + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)
      if sel < 1 then sel = #entries end
      if sel > #entries then sel = 1 end
      if lib_page_of(sel) ~= was then preview_lib(false) end
    elseif action == "ok" then
      local entry = entries[sel]
      if entry then
        -- 历史项直接续读上次页码；收藏项按普通详情打开
        open_comic(entry.item, "lib", entry.kind == "hist")
      end
    end
    return
  end

  local items = grid_items()

  if action == "prev_long" then
    if view == "cat" then
      view = "tags"
      sel = 1
      preview_grid(true)
    elseif view == "latest" then
      view = "lib"
      sel = 1
      preview_lib(true)
    end
    return
  end

  if action == "next_long" then
    if view == "latest" then
      view = "tags"
      sel = 1
      if #tag_items == 0 then
        show_loading("zero搬运", "正在获取分类…")
        tag_items, problem = load_tags()
      end
      if not problem then preview_grid(true) end
    elseif view == "tags" then
      view = "latest"
      sel = 1
      preview_grid(true)
    end
    return
  end

  if action == "voice_long" then
    return   -- 收藏/历史页之外没有长按语音动作
  end

  if action == "prev" or action == "next" then
    if #items == 0 then return end
    if view == "tags" then
      -- 分类文字列表：只改选中项，重绘交给宿主的局刷（全局刷新就出在这里）
      sel = sel + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)
      if sel < 1 then sel = #items end
      if sel > #items then sel = 1 end
      return
    end
    local was = page_of(sel)
    sel = sel + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)
    if sel < 1 then sel = #items end
    if sel > #items then sel = 1 end
    -- 网格翻到新一页时才重画并补这一页封面，局刷不闪屏
    if page_of(sel) ~= was then preview_grid(false) end
    return
  end

  if action == "ok" then
    if #items == 0 then
      retry()
      return
    end
    local item = items[sel]
    if view == "tags" then
      cat_name = item.text
      cat_tag = item.id
      show_loading("zero搬运", "正在加载「" .. item.text .. "」…")
      cat_items, problem = load_category(item.id)
      if not problem then
        view = "cat"
        sel = 1
        preview_grid(true)
      end
    else
      -- open_comic 自带即时详情页与刷新，这里不要再套「正在打开」或重复刷新
      open_comic(item, view)
    end
  end
end

-- ===== 空闲补图 =====
-- 找当前页面第一个还缺封面、且状态未知的条目；返回 id, w, h
local function next_missing_cover()
  if view == "detail" then
    if not detail or not detail.loaded then return nil end
    local related = detail_related()
    local total = 1 + #related
    local index = detail_window()
    local y = DETAIL_TOP
    while index <= total and y + detail_row_h(index) <= DETAIL_BOTTOM do
      local id = index == 1 and detail.id or related[index - 1].id
      local w = index == 1 and SELF_COVER_W or REL_COVER_W
      local h = index == 1 and SELF_COVER_H or REL_COVER_H
      if not covers[cover_key(id, w, h)] and not cover_state[cover_key(id, w, h)] then
        return id, w, h
      end
      y = y + detail_row_h(index)
      index = index + 1
    end
    return nil
  end
  if view == "lib" then
    local entries = lib_entries()
    local first = (lib_page_of(sel) - 1) * LIB_ROWS + 1
    for row = 1, LIB_ROWS do
      local entry = entries[first + row - 1]
      if entry then
        local id = entry.item.id
        local key = cover_key(id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H)
        if not covers[key] and not cover_state[key] then
          return id, LIB_COVER_W, LIB_COVER_H
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local items = grid_items()
  local first = (page_of(sel) - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1
  for slot = 1, PER_PAGE do
    local item = items[first + slot - 1]
    if item then
      local key = cover_key(item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H)
      if not covers[key] and not cover_state[key] then
        return item.id, COVER_W, COVER_H
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

-- 宿主在按键间隙调用（固件 2.9.18 起）：返回 true 让宿主重绘。
-- 阅读页在这里取回目标页与预取下一页，翻页回调不再被网络请求阻塞；
-- 其他页面每次补一张缺失的封面，进入页面时被打断的封面循环也能陆续补齐。
function on_idle()
  if problem or view == "tags" then return false end
  if sys.pending and sys.pending() then return false end
  if view == "read" then
    if not reader then return false end
    -- 用户等待中的目标页最优先：取回后返回 true 让宿主重绘（新页 + 页码一次刷出）
    local target = reader.loading_index
    if target and target ~= reader.index then
      load_page(target, true)
      return true
    end
    -- 当前页已在屏幕上：空闲时预取下一页，之后的翻页零等待；失败静默不打扰
    if reader.index + 1 < reader.pages then
      prefetch_next()
    end
    return false
  end
  local id, w, h = next_missing_cover()
  if not id then return false end
  get_cover(id, w, h)
  return true
end
